item.title: Rescuers saved some 80 people in Grand Canyon floods that left 2 dead and 1 missing, officials say
item.description: The bodies of two friends — a Texas chiropractor and a martial arts studio owner — have been found after a major flash flood swept through the Grand Canyon.
